conflicts_and_limits: Script disabling does not block every supply-chain compromise despite source complete-defense wording.
Containers and cloud workspaces are not inherently safe from mounted/forwarded host credentials or persistent data destruction.
Interactive signing can be undermined by caching or compromised authorization and does not imply human content review.
Trusted publishing plus provenance does not automatically establish SLSA Build Level 3.
Source high-assurance and balanced attestation-presence policies are different options, not a unified accepted rule.
Sample container image mutable tag, broad no-bypass advice, triage auto-dismissal and runtime-risk filters need independently reviewed local scope.
Historical ecosystem/tool capabilities and incident story are source reports, not verified-current or local evidence.
